 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Colorado Rockies have finished with MLB's worst ERA five seasons in a row. Their altitude problem isn't going anywhere, but they're hoping to ameliorate their pitching situation this offseason.
 They took a step toward doing so on Thursday night, according to ESPN's Jeff Passan , who reported that Colorado is acquiring right-handers Luis Castillo and Davis Martin in a trade with the Chicago White Sox.
 Castillo is a three-time All-Star. The Rockies are reportedly taking on his full salary and sending two prospects to Chicago in the deal.
 This story is being updated.
